style_context: Disabilities awareness — disability rights, accessibility, accommodations, adaptive sports, assistive technology, person-first language, inclusion

images.description: A teenager in a clean Scout uniform shaking hands warmly with a person seated in a wheelchair at a bright community center. Other people of various abilities are visible in the background — someone with a white cane, another person with a prosthetic leg — all engaged in a social gathering. Natural lighting, welcoming atmosphere.

Split comparison image. Left side: a dim, sterile institutional hallway from the 1970s with cinderblock walls and fluorescent lighting, suggesting isolation and segregation. Right side: a bright, modern inclusive classroom with students of various abilities learning together — one student using a wheelchair at an accessible desk, another wearing hearing aids, all engaged with a teacher at a whiteboard. The contrast between institutional isolation and modern inclusion is stark.

Six-panel infographic showing categories of disabilities. Each panel has a simple, bold icon and a one-word label beneath: a wheelchair silhouette for Physical, an ear silhouette for Sensory, a brain outline for Intellectual, a heart outline for Mental Health, an open book for Learning, and a figure with a dotted outline for Invisible. Clean white background, modern flat design, each panel uses a distinct color from a warm accessible palette.

Two-column infographic. Left column header has an icon of a person adjusting their technique, labeled Adaptation, with three rows showing simple icons: headphones with a book for audiobooks, a hand tying a knot for modified technique, a swimmer with a different stroke. Right column header has an icon of a building being modified, labeled Accommodation, with three rows showing simple icons: extra time on a clock for test extensions, a reserved parking sign, and a desk at two heights for adjustable workspace. Clean modern layout with blue and green color scheme.

A warm, natural scene of five diverse teenagers including one in a clean Scout uniform having a friendly conversation around a round table in a library or community room. One person is seated in a wheelchair and another is wearing a visible hearing aid. All are engaged, smiling naturally, leaning in to talk. Soft natural light from nearby windows. The focus is on the natural human connection.

A teenager in a clean Scout uniform walking alongside a person with a white cane on a sidewalk. The Scout is slightly ahead with their left arm bent at the elbow, and the person with the cane is lightly holding the Scout's elbow with their right hand, demonstrating the proper sighted guide technique. Both are walking confidently. Daytime, outdoor setting with trees in the background.

Two teenagers having a relaxed, natural conversation in a school hallway. One is seated in a manual wheelchair and the other is sitting in a chair pulled to the same eye level. Both are making eye contact and appear comfortable and engaged. Lockers and a bulletin board are visible in the background. Natural hallway lighting.

A teenager in a clean Scout uniform sitting across a desk from a professional staff member at a disability services office. The Scout has a notebook open and is writing notes. The staff member is gesturing while explaining something. Behind them, informational brochures and posters about disability services are visible on the walls. Professional office lighting.

A bright community center activity room where a diverse group of adults and young adults with various disabilities are engaged in a job skills training workshop. Several people are at computers, one person in a wheelchair is working at an accessible desk, and a facilitator is helping someone review documents. Professional but warm atmosphere with motivational posters on the wall.

An action shot of a wheelchair basketball game in progress. Two athletes in lightweight sport wheelchairs are racing down a polished gym court, one reaching up to shoot the ball toward the basket. Both athletes wear team jerseys and show intense competitive focus. Other players and spectators are visible in the background. Bright gymnasium lighting captures the speed and athleticism.

A teenager in a clean Scout uniform standing at the front of a meeting room, presenting to a group of younger Scouts seated in a semicircle. The presenter has a colorful poster board on an easel with simple graphics about disability awareness. The audience of younger Scouts in uniforms is attentive and one has a hand raised to ask a question. Troop flags are visible in the background.

A teenager in a clean Scout uniform standing at the entrance of a public building, holding a clipboard and pen, looking evaluatively at the entrance. The building entrance prominently features both a concrete ramp with metal handrails and a set of stairs side by side, plus an automatic door opener button on the wall. Daytime, clear weather.

A clean diagram of a building entrance showing key accessibility features. The diagram shows a front view of a building entrance with the following labeled elements in a simple line-art style: a wheelchair ramp with handrails on the left, stairs in the center, an automatic door opener button near the door, a tactile warning strip at the top of the stairs, an accessible parking sign in front, and a curb cut in the sidewalk. Clean white background with thin black lines and blue highlight labels.

A calm, softly-lit quiet room in a community building designed as a sensory-friendly space. The room has comfortable seating including a bean bag chair and a padded bench, dim adjustable floor lamps with warm light, muted wall colors in sage green and cream, and a small sign on the open door. No harsh fluorescent lighting. Soft textures on the furniture. The room feels peaceful and inviting.

A group of six staff members in a bright training room sitting in a discussion circle. One person is standing at a whiteboard with simple drawn icons representing different types of invisible disabilities. The participants are engaged, some taking notes on clipboards, others nodding. Professional but warm atmosphere with natural light from windows.

A teenager in a clean Scout uniform giving a presentation to a group of younger Scouts in a well-lit meeting room. The presenter is standing confidently next to a colorful tri-fold poster board on a table. The poster has simple icons and large text about disability awareness topics. The audience of eight younger Scouts in uniforms is seated in chairs, engaged and watching. The room has a tile floor and fluorescent lights typical of a community center.

A teenager in a clean Scout uniform sitting alone on a wooden park bench, writing thoughtfully in a small journal or notebook. Late afternoon golden light filters through nearby trees. The Scout has a contemplative, focused expression and is clearly deep in thought. A peaceful park setting with green grass and a walking path visible in the background.

Split comparison image. Left side: a physical therapist in clinical attire helping a young person perform balance exercises on parallel bars in a modern rehabilitation gym with exercise equipment visible in the background. Right side: a special education teacher sitting one-on-one with a student at a desk with colorful adaptive learning materials, picture cards, and a tablet device. Both scenes show warm, professional interactions.

A teenager in a clean Scout uniform visiting a prosthetics workshop. A prosthetist in a lab coat is showing the Scout a modern prosthetic hand, holding it so the Scout can see the mechanical components. The workshop has tools, prosthetic components, and plaster molds visible on shelves in the background. The Scout is taking notes in a small notebook with an expression of fascination.

Four-panel infographic showing universal design in everyday life. Panel 1: a lever-style door handle with a small hand icon showing easy grip. Panel 2: a TV screen with closed caption text visible at the bottom. Panel 3: two drinking fountains at different heights side by side. Panel 4: a sidewalk curb cut with textured warning strip. Each panel has a simple label below. Clean modern design with a consistent blue and white color scheme.
